      THE ROLE OF HAARP IN THE WTC ATTACK
      HAARP is now a major portion of the US miltary's world command and
control system
           BJ News (Oct. 19, 2001)   HAARP, a massively powerful shortwave
transmitter in Alaska, operated by the US Navy, Air Force and a group of
universities, was last on the air 3 days ago at medium power with no
military pre-tones indicating on-going university research during the dark
of the new moon on Oct 14. This experiment was also performed in the same
manner for 2 days last month during the dark of the moon around September
15th. Other than that, HAARP has virtually not been on the air for the last
6 months, except for dark moon periods. This normal university research
program indicates that something distinctly and critically different
occurred at HAARP on September 11th and the day following the World Trade
Center attack.

           Within the first 3 hours after the WTC attack, President Bush
placed the US military on world-wide highest DefCon Four alert. The US has a
fleet of about 27 active duty nuclear submarines many of which are on duty
stations at secret locations deep in the oceans around the world. When in
deep water the submarines can only receive communication from the outside
world by ULF radio transmissions in the range of 1 to 10 Hz. How could they
all be notified of the WTC DefCon Four alert?

           Just hours after the WTC attack, and shortly after Bush announced
the military alert, HAARP began maximum power transmission using the
standard military 6.25 second pulses with the military pre-tones, and the
long and short 30 and 15 second coded pauses between the pulses. With proper
modulation, HAARP is the only transmitter which can send ULF signals in the
range of 1 to 10 HZ world-wide. This lasted for just over an hour from 3:15
to 4:20 PM local time. Using the very slow binary code speed for ULF
communication this would be sufficient to send a two or three sentence
"alert" message with the reason for the alert to the very deep submarines.

           Exactly four hours later, HAARP returned to the air at maximum
power, again using the military message protocol to send a lengthy more
detailed 5 hour set of instructions for the submarines from 8:30 PM to about
1:30 AM the next day. This would provide sufficient time to send new
assigned locations and order new pre-selected missile targets. Since those 2
transmissions on September 11th, HAARP has not been on during the day at
high power, nor used the standard military pulses and spacings.

           This would tend to prove that not only is HAARP capable of
communicating with the US deep submarine nuclear fleet, but is actually the
only reliable communication means used by the US Navy for emergency
world-wide alert submarine communications and that HAARP is actually an
operational military facility. That would be the only explanation of the
unique HAARP transmissions right after a world-wide US military alert is
announced. Its nice when you can prove a theory with real data. Despite the
Navy's numerous disclaimers, the BroJon Gazette has for over a year been the
only source which has claimed and proven that the Navy is using HAARP as its
primary operational communication system with the nuclear sub fleet. Can the
proof of our explanation about the use of HAARP by the Air Force as a
primary space-warfare weapon, be far behind?

OK, I'll take the bait...

I live on the "western front" too, and my hum has been *anything* but
quiet.  In fact some of the most horrific days in a long time occurred
last week with concurrent humming and rumbling, which in itself has
become unusual in recent months.  New is a kind of quick cycling, for
lack of a better term - kind of a heavy throbbing, if you will, which is
not present now, but was before the weekend. The hum is still above
average about a 4 on a scale of 6 and is impossible to tune-out.
Considering recent intensities, this is about as good as it gets.
(Baseline is 2)

I really do not believe from the variety of descriptions we see on the
list that we are all hearing the same sound (or signal), although we may
all be experiencing similar observations and/or symptoms.  Consequently,
it would not be expected for everyone to report the same thing at the
same time.

So, JConn... you say that you are a hearer too... What has *your* hum
been doing since 9/11?

Judy,

then our ears don't all work the same.  I didn't notice anything Sunday
until about midnight PDT.  I live on Washington's Olympic Peninsula near the
ocean.  I hear the hum most days.  Quiet days are rare.  Also, there is an
old Air Force radar site near here in Neah Bay.  There is some federal
government activity going on there now.  There was recently a notice put
out(after Sept. 11) at the prison where I work that security guards were

applicants would have to pass a federal background check.  I've heard that
this site is FAA, but I do not know for sure.

I am posting the entirety of your letter above to the list pursuant to
your mention of "for the sake of all of us". I did not see that your
letter was directed to the list unless it hasn't come across yet. 

Of course. We have many towers of all kinds here in California.  I will
check out the links you sent and see if any of those towers are remotely
near me. Of particular interest to me are the Loran-C towers, one of
which is located in Middleton, CA and another Fallon, NV, which is just
about the same distance from me as the Middleton tower. There is also an
installation of some type in Petaluma, but I did not understand the logo
on the map I saw. I do know that there is a Coast Guard Training Center
located there. As Middleton is an easier drive, I hope to be able to
visit that site when my free time increases to see if I can detect any
difference in the hum.

I am not making a statement as to the cause of the hum, but choose to
keep an open mind, even to the possibility that the perceived hum
"sound" might be some physiologic response to some stimulus we are
unfortunate enough to be receiving. I believe the lower frequency and
less frequent rumble is acoustic, as it can occasionally be felt. I have
not even assumed it to related to military activity, although I do think
the recent step-up in intensity and variability is interesting, and this
is certainly a possibility.

My sole reason for posting was to share my recent observations with the
list for whatever purpose it might serve, inasmuch as several have
reported absence of hum in recent weeks. I think it would be an error to
assume that we are all hearing the same phenomenon from the same source,
as everything I have read here for the last six years would seen to
indicate otherwise.

Judy

ludicrous. Passing a bill of this nature is exactly the same as giving the
federal government free roam of your personal affairs. Would you let the FBI
listen to your calls? How about sift through AND LOG your emails for later
review? What if you were formerly charged for treason for talking the way
you do (on this list or otherwise) about this government? This is exactly
what will happen if we follow their lead blindly.

DO NOT FORGET THE PAST, IT IS WHAT GOT US TO THE PRESENT AND WILL SAVE US
FROM THE FUTURE!

If you hate hackers ... take it up with the companies who fail to do their
jobs in writing software. If I build an airplane and that plane crashes
because of a mechanical defect ... who's fault is it? Do we go after the
airline or after the manufacture? There is such little understanding of the
information technology industry that people, all to often, listen to what
they are told without question.  Software vendors, like Microsoft, should be
held accountable for the blatant disregard for my safety when using their
product. But you have not seen this. No class action lawsuits claiming
negligence.... why is that? Maybe its the same reason that we don't stand up
for our rights as Americans ... we don't care. We say we do, but our actions

in the 70's and has gotten worse ever since.

Wake up people .. its showtime

For some of us, there's no relative surprise that
the North/South orientation of the Hum may be
absent.

If { and that's an assumption} ELF was used after
the WTC incident, it would have been to summon the
subs to the surface to recive specific
instructions over the Satnet, or HF relays.  I
would not expect a steady strem of ELF signals
after that initial summons, as that was not the
original purpose of the system.  It's strategic,
not tactical.

.
Having said that, if there are any other questions
I can answer, let me know.

Additionally, regarding hackers. It may not be the
responsibility of the computer manufacterer to
keep the cretins out of your machines, it is your
responsibility.  Lock your doors at night, secure
your car, and shield your computer to keep the bad
guys away. It's not expensive, it's not difficult,
and it's worth the time to travel the learning
curve.

If you would like suggestions as to specific
programs and countermeasures, let me know.

R*

Hi Robert and John and group!

I was born and have lived most of my life in Oklahoma.  My son is part =
native American, some of my best friends are native American. I myself, =
am part native American! I certainly realize that what happened when =
people from the old world came  taking land that belonged to native =
Americans or whatever it was before it was called America, maybe New =
World was not a most admirable situation.    The time for hate should be =
long gone though, because no matter who we are, or where we came from,  =
we have all suffered injustices of one kind or another at some point in =
time, and I do mean all people. The list could go on forever. All I can =
say is, GET OVER IT, grow up!  Grow up fast!  Get educated about your =
countries government,  express what you don't like and what you do like, =
at least you can say you tried to make a difference and you might see =
something that you like, but to sit back and complain or delight in =
degrading it,  is negative fatalism.  This is a totally different world =
than it once was.  You can be wiped out overnight by religious fanatism =
or fundmentalism who love to hate those who do not believe with them.  =
What an excuse to exercise hate from within.  True religion does not =
hate!  It works to make things better for all. Know the difference.=20

This is a list for sufferers of the hum and I would wish that it would =
stay such, without all this other that has nothing to do with it.

Best regards,

Anne


Anne

Bob: one of my  favorite topics!  If one studies past civilizations one =
finds that they all follow a definite curve of rise, peak, decline. I =
believe we are in the decline stage.  This is not deemed to be a 'bad' =
thing, only a shift to a hopefully higher plane, which will, of course =
entail much duress in it s occurrence.  Labor pains are no fun.  Art =
Bell's site, The Quickening, is a very appropriate term for the =
beginning of  the birth. Time has yet to pass till the 'birth' takes =
place, but the  quickening is here. From that point on time moves =
rapidly, and the life to be gets more and more apparent. The present =
also gets more uncomfortable.  (I have three kids) heh.=20

Man has not changed since his creation..and his societies have all been =
violent, cruel, and vengeful.  There has been good too, always, but =
which dominates?  You, as an american Indian should know the answer to =
this question..sadly. I do feel the anglo(which I am..nutty Norwiegen) =
is the most agressive and self-serving of all races..perhaps because we =
are so skilled in our technology. I do not say this is a flaw, well, =
maybe, but we are very dominating and skillful in war. The Taliban are =
not as sophisticated, but they have the cunning, cleverness, and smarts =
to use more "primitive", but effective methods to 'war' with  us. I do =
not think we should underestimate them. I am a devoted American, but =
have my "beef's with our government, and foresee them getting worse as =
this new age of terrorism gives them free play to incoroprate control =
over our own people under the guise of protection.  I fear this much. I =
do not wish to sound unpatriotic, I am not, but I do have the ability to =
look at both sides of issues, when I choose to that is, and feel we =
should all look at  the BIG picture.  It is bigger than we know. =
Kathleen=20

  In my search ,i find myself at the beggining...i find that mankind =
seems to romantically portray a beautiful picture of the ancient =
civilizations,showing them as a ideal society with no =
problems....everyone living in harmony and unison and working toward a =
common goal......agree???   as i look beneath the serface i find many =
who did not live in their truth,,,they  did not express themselfs in =
their truth,,,,.. they took actions that were improper---improper for   =
them in relations to their service to their creator....history always =
repeats itself,,and this is quite true....agree???  if i look at =
thisworld at the present time and through out the course of its history =
,,,i can see great similarities in attitudes and behavior to those of =
certain segments of the ancient ones....the struggles for power,,,for =
controll of others,,,the developmentof weapontry ,,,of power sources to =
establish controll  of military and personally,,,, the modurn  days =
experiments with life,,,cloneing images of ourselves to create pure =
specimens of mankind,,,in the end these ancient civilizations  were =
destroyed ...in the end of our segment of history ,,,those same =
vibrations  must be destroyed,,,,however the method of destruction does =
not necassarily have to be the same .....the object is that mankind must =
learn from its past actions....it must  learn  that it need not suffer =
this type of distruction,,,,that it can be transmuted....this is what is =
hoped will occur on the  surface  of this  planet  and to this point the =
great leaps in consciousness are occuring and the  coming together is =
also takeing place....     namaste    BOB

Let me be as brief as possible because I hate long posts. I'll try to address 
the two most recent posts on this topic with one response. 

Let's look at the facts as we know them from reading what people report on  
this list.

Some people hear the hum all the time, or almost all the time. 

Others experience interludes of quiet.  Sometimes this quiet will last only a 
day or so.  Other times, for some people, this quiet will last for weeks or 
months. (And of course, most people don't hear the hum at all, even if they 
live in the same household or neighborhood as a hummer. There was also a post 
a number of months ago from a hummer who went to Taos, New Mexico and 
reported that while there she didn't hear the hum. I found that interesting.)

My initial post on this topic was prompted after I read recent posts from a 
couple of people saying they were experiencing periods of quiet.  "Man,"  I 
thought to myself, "if ever there was a time for heightened military 
communications, this is it!"  So how does that square with the hypothesis 
that a military communication system is responsible for the hum?

Someone said ELF would only be used to raise submarines to get the real 
message via radio.  Sure, that makes eminent good sense. ELF is a very slow 
transmitter of information. But then how does that square with people who 
hear the hum all, or most, of the time?

Someone else indicated that maybe a transmitter in Washington State is down.  
At this critical time?  And for what?  Does a department store close its toy 
department at Christmastime for repainting? I don't think so.
Mr. Stanton said he heard the hum start up again Sunday evening, but gjsend, 
who lives on the Olympic Peninsula in Washington State, reported it didn't 
start up again until midnight Sunday.  
And what of the person in Northern California who was still hearing the hum 
while others reported it was quiet?
Where is that person getting the signal from?   And what of the people for 
whom the hum remained constant?

All this doesn't square with a military communications system. It's far too 
sporadic. Some hear quiet for days, weeks, or months.  Others hear a 
constant, or nearly constant, hum. 

You can dream up various explanations to try to hammer the facts to fit your 
theory, but at that point your theory dies the death of a thousand 
qualifications. It's more reasonable to consider an etiology of individual 
causation. What that cause is, or whether there are multiple causes, well, 
now we're in the realm of guessing.

Hi JConn and all,

some facts and some thoughts:
the navy comms of interest are in the LF/VLF range with a signal bandwidth of 50
baud.
The radiated power spans from a couple hundred kW to MWs.
There is a network of transmitters covering the whole place, overlapping with
each other.
The modulation scheme is MSK.

The above are the perfect ingredients for the hum, and why?

The hum is omnipresent, as are the powerful ground/sea penetrating EM waves from
these stations.
The carrier frequencies make it into the human body/brain easily.

The 50 baud MSK modulation contains frequency components which cover the whole
range of bioactive frequencies up to about 80 Hz which of course overlaps with
the lower hearing range.

The code being transmitted can only be interpreted as random - this is how a
majority of hummers describe the modulation in the perceived loudness.
The information being transmitted determines the perceived hum frequency by
altering the sequence of "0" and "1". F.e. a "10101010..." sequence @ 50 baud,
the perceived frequency would be 50 Hz, at "110011001100...." the perceived
frequencies would be 25 Hz and its second and third harmonics at 50 Hz and 75 Hz.

Please note, that due to filtering on the transmitter side, no signal content
above 80 Hz take the big ride.
The brain averages the incoming frequency mix which again is dependent on the
type of information being "received".
This averaging also depends on the individual's internal make up. One person
might be more sensitive to a higher frequency (like around 70 Hz), the other
person might be more sensitive to lower frequencies - this has nothing to do with
the hearing curve which of course rolls off significantly toward the lower end.

"heightened military activity" doesn't mean more LF/VLF transmitter power is
needed or present during these events. The information transmitted in these times
looks totally identical to "peaceful time" code namely seemingly random. Only
through sophisticated signal processing it becomes useful information.

cheers, Peter.

>Hi JConn and all,
>
>some facts and some thoughts:
>the navy comms of interest are in the LF/VLF range with a signal bandwidth 
>of 50
>baud.
>The radiated power spans from a couple hundred kW to MWs.
>There is a network of transmitters covering the whole place, overlapping 
>with
>each other.
>The modulation scheme is MSK.
>
>The above are the perfect ingredients for the hum, and why?
>
>The hum is omnipresent, as are the powerful ground/sea penetrating EM waves 
>from
>these stations.
>The carrier frequencies make it into the human body/brain easily.
>
>The 50 baud MSK modulation contains frequency components which cover the 
>whole
>range of bioactive frequencies up to about 80 Hz which of course overlaps 
>with
>the lower hearing range.
>
>The code being transmitted can only be interpreted as random - this is how 
>a
>majority of hummers describe the modulation in the perceived loudness.
>The information being transmitted determines the perceived hum frequency by
>altering the sequence of "0" and "1". F.e. a "10101010..." sequence @ 50 
>baud,
>the perceived frequency would be 50 Hz, at "110011001100...." the perceived
>frequencies would be 25 Hz and its second and third harmonics at 50 Hz and 
>75 Hz.
>
>Please note, that due to filtering on the transmitter side, no signal 
>content
>above 80 Hz take the big ride.
>The brain averages the incoming frequency mix which again is dependent on 
>the
>type of information being "received".
>This averaging also depends on the individual's internal make up. One 
>person
>might be more sensitive to a higher frequency (like around 70 Hz), the 
>other
>person might be more sensitive to lower frequencies - this has nothing to 
>do with
>the hearing curve which of course rolls off significantly toward the lower 
>end.
>
>"heightened military activity" doesn't mean more LF/VLF transmitter power 
>is
>needed or present during these events. The information transmitted in these 
>times
>looks totally identical to "peaceful time" code namely seemingly random. 
>Only
>through sophisticated signal processing it becomes useful information.
>
>cheers, Peter.
>
>

are trying to enter the age of the Universal Empire with the United =
States as the core of the empire, but we haven't done it yet.  So, I =
think Kathleen that you and dear Art maybe a bit premature in your =
prediction of the end of western civilization, just as the historians =
were pemature in predicting the death of the Islamic civilization back =
in the 1960's.=20

  Man has not changed since his creation..and his societies have all =
been violent, cruel, and vengeful.  There has been good too, always, but =
which dominates?  You, as an american Indian should know the answer to =
this question..sadly. I do feel the anglo(which I am..nutty Norwiegen) =
is the most agressive and self-serving of all races..perhaps because we =
are so skilled in our technology. I do not say this is a flaw, well, =
maybe, but we are very dominating and skillful in war. The Taliban are =
not as sophisticated, but they have the cunning, cleverness, and smarts =
to use more "primitive", but effective methods to 'war' with  us. I do =
not think we should underestimate them. I am a devoted American, but =
have my "beef's with our government, and foresee them getting worse as =
this new age of terrorism gives them free play to incoroprate control =
over our own people under the guise of protection.  I fear this much. I =
do not wish to sound unpatriotic, I am not, but I do have the ability to =
look at both sides of issues, when I choose to that is, and feel we =
should all look at  the BIG picture.  It is bigger than we know. =
Kathleen

  I feel that I should point out to you that the vestiges of the Viking =
civilization are to be found in Russian civilization and thought NOT in =
Western civililzation and thought.  I might add, just so you don't think =
that I'm dissing your nordic heritage, I'm 75% Nordic myself.   Russian =
civilization derives from three sources,from the classical thru  1. =
Slavic, 2. Viking and 3. Byzantine civilizations.  Western civilization =
passed from classic  by way of the universal empire of Rome into the =
dark ages and then into it's current form.  The dark ages are very =
important in our development by the way, something that neither the =
Islamic or Russian experienced and something that greatly changed the =
way we think.  You might want to read "Tragedy and Hope, A History of =
The World In Our Time" by Carroll Quigley.  He is/was considered one of =
the most influencial historians of the late 20th century.  I'm not sure =
if he is still alive or not, the above book was written in the early to =
mid 1960's and is quite facinating to read now 35 years later and in =
light of recent events.

  You find "anglo's" more agressive and self serving.  Well, I think =
that "anglo's" are more successful, not more agressive.  I haven't seen =
any great unagressive stances put forth by Islam, Russia, =
China...whoever.  Other civilazations have been more apt to turn their =
agressivness on their own, rather than on the west and for a very good =
reason.  When weapons are easy to use and/or easy to come by, we have =
democracies.  When they are hard to use and/or hard to come by, we have =
autocracies. Autocracies have to spend a lot of time maintaining =
internal order.  If we in the west have anything to fear, it is that =
weapons are becoming much more specialized, expensive and hard to come =
by.  This is a formula for a specialized armed forces which can eventuly =
be turned on it's own...us. =20

  As for more "self serving", what you do not seem to understand is the =
difference in thinking between Western civilization on one hand and =
Russian and Islamic on the other hand.  Those in Western civilization =
believe that they have the power to make a difference in their lives, =
here and now, make things better, more comfortable and a duty to their =
"god" to do so.  Russian and Islamic civilizations beleive that their =
entire reward is in the next life, not this one.  They are cast in a =
part from birth and that is where they will stay their whole life.  By =
suffering in this life for their "god", they will reap great rewards in =
the next life. =20

  So, if you believe that you can make a difference in your life and the =
lives of those around you, here and now and that you have a duty to your =
"god" to do so, then you might find better means of sanitation, desease =
control and cures, growing more and better food. Self serving, well =
yeah.  If on the other hand, you believe that life is what it is, and =
your only hope and only reward is in the next life, you might be willing =
to accept great hardships.  You might make use of what others have done =
and learned, but you aren't likely to try to make your life or the lives =
of those around you better.  You aren't likely to go searching for a =
cure to a desease or a better means of growing food because these things =
are fleeting and of this world.  Are they any less self serving?  No.  =
It's just that they are attempting to make a better life in the next =
life, not this one. =20

    Cathy  =20

Those are all good. The one thing I can think to add may be a little too 
elaborate to construct, but here it is.  There is a hum simulation recording 
that's been around that sounds pretty close to the real hum.  Would it be 
possible to make 5 click on buttons each with an increasing level of loudness 
of hum?  The responder would then be asked to match the hum they're hearing 
to one of the 5 volume levels. This would give everyone an agreed upon scale. 

One problem I can think of with this is that we each have volume controls on 
our computers, so depending on how my volume is adjusted, the level 4 sound 
on the webpage I hear might not match the level 4 sound you hear coming out 
of your computer. There would have to be a way to make sure we're all hearing 
the same loudness of sound at each of the designated levels.  That could be 
done with a VU meter, but I imagine only a few of us have them.

good suggestion JConn,

a simple yet effective way to overcome the volume adjuster problem is to download
a low volume reference tone @ say 70 Hz first.
The person doing the test then adjusts his/her volume knob until the tone becomes
barely audible in a quiet listening environment (I know, there are these pesky
fans....)
Then the test tones can be downloaded, listened to and ticked off.

The problem with my hum f.e. is that it is very faint, even the PC fan masks it
most of the time.

cheers, Peter.

Kathleen, I appologize for misunderstanding your post. =20

I have, in the past, listened to Mr. Bell's radio program and I do =
ocassionally visit Mr. Drudge's web page.  As with many such sights, I =
believe that there is truth to be found there, but I believe there is =
also deception to be found there.  Intentional or deliberate, I do not =
know.  While it is critical that we know our own history and motivation, =
it is even more important that we know the history and motivation of =
those that would influence us or challenge us. Without this knowledge, =
it becomes easy for others to mislead us into vilifying things that are =
actually good and/or romanticizing things that never exisisted in the =
first place.  I think this is true for the individual, a nation or a =
civilization.

As "hummers", some of us suspect that the "hum" or those behind the =
"hum" threaten our body, mind and spirit.  It is one of the reasons that =
emotions on the list tend to run high from time to time. We have few =
facts, so we tend to cast a wide net.  Knowledge is power and =
protection, but it is also true that a little bit of knowledge can be a =
dangerous thing.  We must step back and look at the wider picture from =
time to time, understand the history and the motivation behind those =
providing the information we rely on.  I once worked as a statistician =
and we were often able to make the numbers support any hypothesis we =
wanted.  A good manager looked bad, a bad manager looked good.  Often =
the history of the person making the report was more relevent than the =
facts and numbers on the report.

So, be careful, take nothing at face value, not on this list, not in =
life.  Cathy    =20

Good Day Bride: That color was not right!!  The Hum:  My husband and I =
first heard it  in l993 in Four Corners, USA.  He heard it first, did =
not tell me, I heard it  the next  night..relayed  my hearing to him, he =
then relayed his experience with the hum to me.  We both thought we were =
nuts, until we arrived in San Antonio, Tx. and I heard that people all =
over the world were hearing it (on news report).  Felt greatly reassured =
to say the least.  Did not know about this site until Feb. of 01 when I =
saw a program on t.v. and decided to see what other people had heard and =
thought .  I read  the many theories put forth by this site, and the =
technical, and some not so technical speculations on origin of hum.  I =
wrote to Peter once, but he thought I was a spiritual wierdo and  only =
wrote back once to tell non-serious people like me to stay off the site. =
He meanwhile was sticking his head in sewer pipes(clean ones).  I wish I =
could open up and tell all of  you the  way I believe, and why I believe =
the hum is here.  But,  from most of what  I HAVE READ< AND My (OOPS) =
tentative attempts at communication, I FEEL MY IDEAS WOULD NOT BE =
WELCOMED WITH OPEN ARMS> (OOPS again)  (my shift sticks) .

Oh well, what the hey,  my husband and I are not church-goers, not =
spiritualists, not  involved with any groups or cults, or man-made =
religions.  But, we have had numerous  spiritual  occurrences , and I =
believe the hum is   one of them.  I do not think it  is from Haarp, or  =
elf's,(yes, I know what that is), or the military, or  shifts in the =
geology of the earth, or destruction of the ozone layer, or cell phones, =
or computers, or anything like that.  Why do I believe this?  Because  =
we  have only heard the hum twice, very clearly, very strongly, and  if =
it were due to a man-made "thing", we would still be hearing it.  Oh, we =
also do not use drugs, booze or other mind-altering substances.  I, =
personally, have  "epiphanies";  I had one about the WTC about 3 months =
before it happened, and also on the night before it took place. =
Sorry,but  it's true.

The morning it happened I left for  work at 8:45, (dental lab =
tech..ceramist) , and as I only had a few units to do I said to =
myself"Well, I'll be home in one hour". Then The Voice(spirit.whatever =
one chooses to call it) said as clearly as if someone were in the car =
with me" Many things can change in one hour>"  OK......I knew that voice =
because I  have heard it on many instances in the past, but I  did not =
analyze, just went to work, but kept thinking" I will be home in one =
hour", and each time would hear the same response:"Many things can =
change in one hour"

One hour later I was at a Citgo getting gas, on my way home, and I saw =
the Wtc events on a tv in the corner of the store. I stood, numbed, with =
the Muslim(yes) clerk, and we both felt immense sorrow, and then I knew =
why I had heard what I heard one hour before.  The Hum??

Isaiah 27:13 "And it shall come to pass in that day, that the  great =
trumpet shall be blown"   When I dreamed of the WTC event  (where I SAW =
New York City in ashes, and people covered with ashes walking blindly =
down darkened streets, with their hands outstretched in front of them,  =
and the skeleton of what I know now was the WTC in the background rising =
 like a mighty ribcage ) I was told by the voice: The Wolf IS at the =
door.   I woke up  and called my boss, who is from  New York and  my =
husband.  I went to the Bible and opened it, as I do when I need to know =
I have heard what I heard, and I opened  to a book there I had never =
heard of: Zephaniah.

My eye fell on this sentence only:"Hold thy peace at the presence of  =
the Lord God:for the day of the Lord IS at hand: for the Lord hath =
prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests." ZEP: 1:7
 (I did not  change that  color there)
Then I read Zep3:6    "I have cut off the nations,their towers are =
desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by;  their =
cities are destroyed,  so that there is no man, that there is none =
inhabitant>"  O.K..   So, now you KNOW I must be nuts, huh?   No, not =
even certified psychotic, sadly enough.  Since I've exposed myself this =
far  I   may as well tell you that 30 years ago ,at the age of 20, I was =
told by this same voice that  ' in 30 years the world will be assailed =
by so many blows from all corners that people will bow their heads in =
fear and confusion, and look  to many sources for  why and where  these =
blows are coming. but most will not look up to see the true source, =
which is written for those who dare to  read.  Fear not, for the time is =
not come yet, but only the beginning of sorrows.  Keep your head up, and =
look at the evil, so you may know  your enemy."  I had never read the =
Bible, or knew of Revelations, or had religious training.    He came to =
me. =20

Now, the 30 years have passed, and the time is here, and I do not know =
where  or how fast it  will go, but I believe what I was told: The wolf =
IS at the door.  And the trump has sounded.  This excludes no religion, =
no faith, for  there is one God, and  many mansions.  I have so much =
more to tell you, but  will most likely not hear from any of you again =
after this letter. But then, I never did before..so I  sow the seed, as =
I  am bid.  Very nice chatting with you. Kathleen

Dear John:       oops, being funny again.  when I first  had that dream it
was 3 months before the attack, and though I always know when it is not a
"normal" dream, but a sent message I have a hard time to apply it to events
that have not yet occurred.  I told my husband, and my boss because he is
from New York(I've never been), and vic said all I could do was wait and see
what it meant.  My boss did  take me seriously, said I had the gift of
prophecy, but could not interpret.  The morning of the attack I was going
about normal day, driving son to school, on my way to work, and The Voice
that kept coming to me each time I thought" I will be home in one hour"
said'Many things can change in one hour."  I was puzzled, and pondered this
as I had a very sleepless night the night before, even writing my brother at
3:30 titling it "Spooks", for I felt them in the 'air'.  But it was not
until I saw the tragedy on t.v., one hour after I left home, that the reason
the voice had come to me became clear.

So, what could I have done? I say to you all on this site, being bid to do
so by my inner knowledge, but with great trepidation knowing how
technically-minded you are, that the wolf is at the door, just as I was told
3 months ago, and he is not an easy, or uncunning beast.  Who hears, will
hear.  Old Binnie is just his temporal tool.  His death will not end this
wolves advance.

Well, nite-nite, adn thank you for your decent letter. kathleen

In a message dated 10/25/01 12:02:37 PM Eastern Daylight Time, 
arider2@hotmail.com writes:

<< Carefull, K.T.. Dont get cought in the Conns garbage trap!! RS >>

Garbage?  Don't we all wish we could have had some foreknowledge which would 
have prevented or diminished the horrendous loss of life which occurred on 
9/11 ?  I know I do. I knew someone who worked at Cantor Fitzgerald. I can't 
claim him as a friend, but I was acquainted with him. I said hello once to 
Barbara Olson at a conference. She was pretty, charming, and very 
intelligent.  I wish I had a time machine and could go back and change what 
happened.  If you don't have such an impulse, I'd have to question your 
humanity. 

Someone else said if you had tried to warn people, you'd just end up getting 
arrested. Without getting into the particulars of how one could notify the 
authorities, there are many other creative ways to convey a warning. The Art 
Bell show has been mentioned in this group. He's open to such things, and 
millions of people listen to that show. You could call his open lines and 
state your warning. The passion and conviction in your voice would cause 
people to listen and remember your prediction. By now you'd be hailed as the 
psychic of the century, and who knows how many people in the WTC might have 
been listening? 1? 100? 1,000? You would have urged them to get out at the 
first sign of trouble. You could have planted a seed in their minds. Remember 
all those people who were in the stairwell who turned around and went back to 
their offices?  How many of those could you have saved? 

And calling Art Bell is just one way I can think of to approach the problem. 

I know if I had a history of making predictions and having them come true, I 
couldn't live with myself if I knew about the 9/11 massacre in advance and 
did nothing to at least try to warn people.

    To all  who have talked, guided, bantered, and greeted me, a poem by =
theodore Roethke.



                                              The Waking



    I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.
    I feel my fate in what I cannot fear.=20
    I learn by going where I have to go.

    We think by feeling. What is there to know?
    I hear my being dance from ear to ear.
    I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.

    Of those so close beside me, which are you?
    God bless the Ground!
    I shall walk softly there,=20
    and learn by going where I have to go.

    Light takes the Tree; but who can tell us how?
    The lowly worm climbs up a winding stair;
    I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.

    great Nature has another thing to do
    to you and me; so take the lively air,
    and lovely, learn by going where to go.

    This shaking keeps me steady.    I  should know.
    What falls away is always. and is near.=20
    I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.
    I learn by going where I have to go.






    thank you all,even (heh) Beefbone, JC, everyone I have met on this =
site. Need to recluse now.  but know you have all added to my life. =
Kathleen

  ----- Original Message -----=20
  From: Vic and Kathleen Thorn=20

  Sent: Friday, October 26, 2001 8:35 AM
  Subject: Worn out now..Parting message from KT


      To all  who have talked, guided, bantered, and greeted me, a poem =
by theodore Roethke.



                                                The Waking



      I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.
      I feel my fate in what I cannot fear.=20
      I learn by going where I have to go.

      We think by feeling. What is there to know?
      I hear my being dance from ear to ear.
      I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.

      Of those so close beside me, which are you?
      God bless the Ground!
      I shall walk softly there,=20
      and learn by going where I have to go.

      Light takes the Tree; but who can tell us how?
      The lowly worm climbs up a winding stair;
      I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.

      great Nature has another thing to do
      to you and me; so take the lively air,
      and lovely, learn by going where to go.

      This shaking keeps me steady.    I  should know.
      What falls away is always. and is near.=20
      I wake to sleep, and take my waking slow.
      I learn by going where I have to go.






      thank you all,even (heh) Beefbone, JC, everyone I have met on this =
site. Need to recluse now.  but know you have all added to my life. =
Kathleen

From: <pagemaster@rocknet.net.au>

>Allan

>10. Article:
>"Home Run"
>Electronically Hijacking the World Trade Center Attack Aircraft
>Copyright Joe Vialls, October 2001
>
>In the mid-seventies America faced a new and escalating crisis, with US
>commercial jets being hijacked for geopolitical reasons. Determined to gain
>the upper hand in this new form of aerial warfare, two American
>multinationals collaborated with the Defense Advanced Projects Agency
>(DARPA) on a project designed to facilitate the remote recovery of hijacked
>American aircraft.
>Brilliant both in concept and operation, "Home Run" [not its real code
>name] allowed specialist ground controllers to listen in to cockpit
>conversations on the target aircraft, then take absolute control of its
>computerized flight control system by remote means. From that point
>onwards, regardless of the wishes of the hijackers or flight deck crew, the
>hijacked aircraft could be recovered and landed automatically at an airport
>of choice, with no more difficulty than flying a radio-controlled model
plane.
>The engineers had no idea that almost thirty years after its initial
>design, Home Run's top secret computer codes would be broken, and the
>system used to facilitate direct ground control of the four aircraft used
>in the high-profile attacks on New York and Washington on 11th September
2001.
>Before moving on to the New York and Washington attacks, we first need to
>look at the ways in which an aircraft is normally controlled by its pilot,
>because without this basic knowledge, Home Run would make no sense. In
>order to control an aircraft in three-dimensional space, the pilot uses the
>control yoke (joystick) in front of him, rudder pedals under his feet, and
>a bank of engine throttles located at his side. Without engine thrust the
>aircraft would not fly at all, so the throttles are largely self
>explanatory: For more speed or altitude increase throttle, for less speed
>or altitude decrease throttle.
>In order to raise or lower the nose of the aircraft, the pilot pulls or
>pushes on the control yoke, which in turn raises or lowers the elevators on
>the horizontal tailplane. To bank the aircraft left or right, the pilot
>moves the control yoke to the left or right, which in turn operates the
>ailerons on the outer wings. Lastly, to turn left or right at low speed or
>"balance" turns at high speed, the pilot presses the left or right rudder
>pedals as required, which in turn move the rudder on the vertical
stabilizer.
>Back in the early days of flight, the control yoke and rudder pedals were
>connected to the various flight control surfaces by thin cables, meaning
>the pilot had direct physical control over every movement the aircraft
>made. This was no great problem for an average man flying a small biplane,
>but as aircraft grew ever bigger, heavier and faster over the years, the
>loadings on the control yoke and rudder pedals became huge, certainly well
>beyond the ability of a single pilot to handle unaided.
>By the late fifties we were well into the age of hydraulics, where just
>like the power steering on your automobile, hydraulic rams were placed in
>line between the pilot's control cables and each individual control
>surface. Now when the pilot moved the control yoke, the cables activated
>sensors, which in turn activated one or more hydraulic rams, which in turn
>moved one or more control surfaces. For the first time since Bleriot and
>the Wright brothers, pilots were of necessity being steadily distanced from
>direct control of their own aircraft.
>When the multinationals and DARPA finally came on the scene in the
>mid-seventies, aircraft systems were even more advanced, with computers
>controlling onboard autopilots, which in turn were capable of controlling
>all of the onboard hydraulics. In combination these multiple different
>functions were now known as the "Flight Control System" or FCS, in turn
>integrated with sophisticated avionics capable of automatically landing the
>aircraft in zero visibility conditions. In summary, by the mid-seventies
>most of the large jets were capable of effectively navigating hundreds of
>miles and then making automatic landings at a selected airport in zero-zero
>fog conditions. All of this could be accomplished unaided, but in theory at
>least, still under the watchful eyes of the flight deck crews.
>In order to make Home Run truly effective, it had to be completely
>integrated with all onboard systems, and this could only be accomplished
>with a new aircraft design, several of which were on the drawing boards at
>that time. Under cover of extreme secrecy, the multinationals and DARPA
>went ahead on this basis and built "back doors" into the new computer
>designs. There were two very obvious hard requirements at this stage, the
>first a primary control channel for use in taking over the flight control
>system and flying the aircraft back to an airfield of choice, and secondly
>a covert audio channel for monitoring flight deck conversations. Once the
>primary channel was activated, all aircraft functions came under direct
>ground control, permanently removing the hijackers and pilots from the
>control loop.
>Remember here, this was not a system designed to "undermine" the authority
>of the flight crews, but was put in place as a "doomsday" device in the
>event the hijackers started to shoot passengers or crew members, possibly
>including the pilots. Using the perfectly reasonable assumption that
>hijackers only carry a limited number of bullets, and many aircraft
>nowadays carry in excess of 300 passengers, Home Run could be used to fly
>all of the survivors to a friendly airport for a safe auto landing. So the
>system started out in life for the very best of reasons, but finally fell
>prey to security leaks, and eventually to compromised computer codes. In
>light of recent high-profile CIA and FBI spying trials, these leaks and
>compromised codes should come as no great surprise to anyone
>
>Activating the primary Home Run channel proved to be easy. Most readers
>will have heard of a "transponder", prominent in most news reports
>immediately following the attacks on New York and Washington. Technically a
>transponder is a combined radio transmitter and receiver which operates
>automatically, in this case relaying data between the four aircraft and air
>traffic control on the ground. The signals sent provide a unique "identity"
>for each aircraft, essential in crowded airspace to avoid mid-air
>collisions, and equally essential for Home Run controllers trying to lock
>onto the correct aircraft. Once it has located the correct aircraft, Home
>Run "piggy backs" a data transmission onto the transponder channel and
>takes direct control from the ground.
>This explains why none of the aircraft sent a special "I have been
>hijacked" transponder code, despite multiple activation points on all four
>aircraft. Because the transponder frequency had already been piggy backed
>by Home Run, transmission of the special hijack code was rendered
>impossible. This was the first hard proof that the target aircraft had been
>hijacked electronically from the ground, rather than by [FBI-inspired]
>motley crews of Arabs toting penknives.
>The Home Run listening device on the flight deck utilizes the cockpit
>microphones that normally feed the Cockpit Voice Recorder (CVR), one of two
>black boxes armored to withstand heavy impact and thereby later give
>investigators significant clues to why the aircraft crashed. However, once
>hooked into Home Run, the CVRs are bypassed and voice transmissions are no
>longer recorded on the 30-minute endless loop recording tape. If Home Run
>is active for more than thirty minutes, there will therefore be no audible
>data on the Cockpit Voice Recorders.
>To date, crash investigators have recovered the CVRs from the Pentagon and
>Pittsburg aircraft, and publicly confirmed that both are completely blank.
>The only possible reason for this, is data capture by Home Run, providing
>the final hard proof that the attack aircraft were hijacked electronically
>from the ground, rather than by "Arab terrorists". (And also giving reason
>for the convoluted flight patterns of the 4 hijacked aircraft. They each
>were required to fly a requisite distance along their main flight pattern
>before "hijack" to give at more than 30 minute flight time from hijack to
>point of impact - Editor)
>Many readers might by now be indignant; convinced this is incorrect or
>misleading information because of "those telephone calls from the hijacked
>aircraft". Which telephone calls exactly? There are no records of any such
>calls, and the emotional claptrap the media fed you in the aftermath of the
>attack was in all cases third-person. We had the media's invisible
>"contact" at an airline who "said" a hostess called to report a hijacking,
>and we had a priest (?) who "said" he received a call from a man asking him
>in turn to call his wife and tell her he loved her. Presumably this man
>would have had his wife's name filed in his cellphone, and faced with
>imminent death would have called her direct. The FAA helped out by claiming
>that it had "overheard" a heated argument from a cockpit where the radio
>transmit switch had been left in the "on" position. When push came to
>shove, the FAA was forced to retract, and admit that the mythical argument
>was not on the tapes at all.
>Whether more information will be forthcoming about Home Run is unknown, but
>nowadays there are large numbers of people apart from the author privy to
>the basic data. As long ago as the early nineties, a major European flag
>carrier acquired the information and was seriously alarmed that one of its
>own aircraft might be "rescued" by the Americans without its authority.
>Accordingly, this flag carrier completely stripped the American flight
>control computers out of its entire fleet, and replaced them with a home
>grown version. These aircraft are now effectively impregnable to
>penetration by Home Run, but that is more than can be said for the American
>aircraft fleet. A casual count indicates around 600 aircraft in the USA and
>elsewhere are still vulnerable and could be used in further attacks at any
>time, which might help explain why America has lately been bombing the
>Afghans primarily with bags of wheat. For the first time in US history,
>American officials appear to be genuinely fearful of future reprisals, and
>justifiably so with 600 giant bombs parked on the wrong side of their
>missile defence shield.
>It is a "Catch 22" situation. In order to make all of the aircraft safe,
>the flight control systems would have to be stripped out and replaced, at a
>cost of billions of dollars the airlines cannot afford because they are
>going broke. Nor is there enough time. The most innovative anti-hijacking
>tool in the American arsenal, has now become the biggest known threat to
>American national security.
>For the purpose of public reassurance I would like to publish a complete
>list of aircraft which cannot be affected by Home Run, but I cannot do so
>for legal reasons. Any aircraft manufacturer not on the list might feel
>inclined to sue me for defamation and I can't afford that. However, there
>is nothing to stop me publishing my personal choice of aircraft for a
>flight from, say, Atlanta to Singapore via JFK, Frankfurt, and Kuala
Lumpur.
> From Atlanta to JFK I would probably travel on a Boeing 737, and connect
>with a Boeing 777 for the onward flight to Frankfurt. At Frankfurt I would
>probably board an Airbus A340 for Kuala Lumpur, and finish the journey to
>Singapore on a DC9 or a Fokker 100. Naturally I might be unlucky enough to
>pick an aircraft with an intoxicated pilot, or an unrelated mechanical
>problem, but apart from those minor risks I'd feel pretty safe
>
>The author is a former member of the Society of Licenced Aeronautical
>Engineers and Technologists, London.
>

Dear Editor,

        In light of recent events in New York City, Americans have been
called upon to reflect upon the state of their lives in the 21st century.
The majority of people probably still favor the United States as the county
of choice considering the amount of civil strife present around the globe.
We do have freedoms that other countries are not afforded, but one
particular freedom, the right to privacy, is being revoked in a subtle way.
How would you say this could be with solid walls between homes, brick,
mortar, and wood forming a protective and mostly impenetrable barrier?
What possible "element" elusively could drift in and out of your home at
will, connecting your movements and even thoughts with those of your
neighbors?  The answer is infrasonic pollution.  What produces infrasonic
pollution?  Before we expose the major culprit, it is important to shed
light on the symptoms it has been proven to cause, mostly by French
scientist and researcher Vladmir Gavreau.  In studies for the French
government, Gavreau built a series of long tubes capable of producing sound
below 20 Hertz, mostly inaudible to the human ear.  In his tests exposure
to low frequency sound caused adverse symptoms in humans so strong to merit
abandonment  of the study.
         American military studies have criticized this "non-lethal" weapon
as too unwieldy to perform adequately in the field.  Infrasound is
omni-directional; it travels equally in all directions.  Without the
ability to control the dispersion of the sound waves, it was useless.
        In America and now other countries, this characteristic is just
what is robbing us of one of our foremost constitutional rights, the right
to privacy.  Aside from the physiological effects it projects onto the
human body, the great strength of extremely long wavelength sound waves
causes our home to vibrate and resonate.  Likewise it acts as a carrier
wave transmitting proximal sounds it gathers along the way to its
destination miles  away.  In essence like no other natural phenomena on
earth, infrasound connects everything in it's path.
        Although infrasound is easily documented with a computer, it is
better described as immense pressure in the air.  You feel infrasound
inside and outside your body.  It is a tactile experience, not an aural
one.   It pressurizes your body cavity, abdomen, chest, and head creating
physiological symptoms often misdiagnosed as psychiatric disorders.
Fatigue, irritability, difficulty concentrating, loss of sleep, labored
breathing, blurred vision, and chronic heart burn are all caused by
infrasound pollution.  Because it cannot be heard, we are enduring these
effects in cognito, suffering politely in our own homes.  Only the
Clintonville Train Coalition has openly voiced their grievances, and
although they don't understand against what they are fighting, they have
identified the right source. It is AC traction technology.
        A decade ago GE and EMD began manufacturing heavy haul locomotives
equipped with AC traction motors rather than traditional DC ones. AC drives
have no commutators or brushes to wear out and the rotors are turned by a
strong, rotating, electro-magnetic field.  To control the speed of the
motors, the frequency of AC power had to be processed with a computer in
proportion to the potential speed of the motor.  Rectified DC current is
fed into a computer that increases and decreases  the frequency in relation
to the speed needs of the train. It then is inverted back to AC with a
grossly invasive IGBT or thrysistor circuit to power the traction motors.
These inverters are the major cause of the preponderance of new, nearly
constant infrasonic pollution in America and abroad.  A "humming" sound is
created by the processed electricity. This vibrating hum creates parallel
infrasonic waves proportional to the frequency of the electricity in the
inverters.  You easily can hear the frequency increase and decrease  like
"beats" or "modulations" in a constant tone. Each time the locomotive
starts or switches cars at a slow speed, the thrysistor produces invasive
infrasound and electro-magnetic pollution.  This phenomenon is the  one
most described by people on the Taos Hum Page, although their particular
hum is produced by thrysistor driven low-frequency drives on a conveyor
belt in the Molybdenum Mine in Questo a few miles away.
        Although many of today's physicists reassure us low frequency
electro-magnetic energy is harmless, the governmental GWEN study (Ground
Wave Emergency Network) documented the dangers of this energy and described
it's effects.  It produces phosphenes, ghostly images seen due to increased
electrical activity in the retina, tissue heating, and tingling on the
skin.  There are various diseases commonly associated with it.
        My question is how did this potentially dangerous technology escape
study by the FDA, escape governmental regulation, and become standard
practice in the rail industry?  Is it because it is invisible and
inaudible? Is it because only a small percentage of the population are
vocal about it?  Should more people speak out?  From personal accounts
often times people who speak out are punished by the railroads with
increased traffic in their area.
        My hypothesis is a variety of new syndromes and actual diseases are
the result of exposure to infrasonic pollution, and people are
unnecessarily suffering in their own private homes, once enclaves for
personal development, tranquillity, and spiritual rejuvenation.  When did
corporate America steal the right to invade our lives and relinquish our
constitutional rights to happiness and privacy?  Do we really want to
abandon hope and a feeling of optimism about life in order to haul freight?

        Give America back her mental health.  Reduce the presence of AC
technology heavy haul locomotives.  Follow the airline industry and enact a
rail activity curfew. Support the psychological and physiological health of
Americans and become a responsible industry.




                                                Sincerely,



                                                Paul A. Reichle lll

Recently the forum has been filled with all sorts of things, but almost
none of it pertains to the Hum, and quite a bit of it directly violates
the forum rules.

This forum is not a democracy, it is a petty dictatorship with no freedom
of speech.  Its rules, although enforced only rarely and sporadically,
have not changed.  Its topic, the HUM, has not changed.  

Huge masses of non-hum postings are not welcome on this list, and they are
now stopped.

Rather than trying to fight with a large number of noisy violators,  I've
decided to unsubscribe everyone.   This forum is now shut down.

However, it shall return in a moment.  Anyone who wishes to participate in
an email forum about the "Taos Hum" can contact me.  I'll require that you
read the forum rules, then give your word to follow them, and also that
you promise to keep the non-HUM postings to an extreme minimum. 

Also, FLAMERS are extremely unwelcome here.  If you want to use this
forum, and if you've recently insulted another user, I'll require that you
apologize to that user.  I know that true Flamers *never* apologize (they
always refuse to accept responsibility for the filth that they spew), and
in this way they'll eliminate themselves. 

For those who don't like this, please go to http://groups.yahoo.com and
start as many email forums as you wish, with whatever rules you wish.  
Once your forum(s) are set up, send me a notice and I'll announce them
here.  Those who wish can then subscribe to your non-HUM discussions.

The TAOSHUM-L rules:     (still have not changed.)

   1. Intelligent, respectful discussion only.  Meaning, no flamewars,
      no namecalling, no insults.  Do not use taoshum-L to reply
      to insults, use private email.  The list moderator is intolerant
      of violators, and they will be immediately unsubscribed.  Please
      stay very aware that the low information content in email can 
      lead us to read between the lines and hear insults where none 
      were intended.  So, think twice (or more!) before replying to
      apparent attack.  If in doubt, ask the author to clarify, or 
      simply take the fight to private email. 

   2. Outsiders and new subscribers may not post advertizements on this
      list.  Regular users of taoshum-L may post ads if they are
      somewhat on-topic.  If in doubt, ask the group.

   3. Small postings only.  The limit is currently set to 40K.  Some
      users have mailbox limits, others must pay by the K for received
      messages.  Do not attempt to circumvent the 40K boundary by
      splitting up files into separate messages.  Large audio files can be
      mailed directly to interested individuals.  If you would like to
      post something on this web page, mail me at billb@eskimo.com
      for more info.
